a.lede: The San Jose, California, branch of Denny's once featured a plaque commemorating the booth where Jensen Huang and his two other co-founders worked to build Nvidia.
a.title: Commemorative plaque at Denny’s booth where Nvidia was born has been removed in wake of Jensen Huang scandals

b.lede: In his first statement since his resignation, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang expressed openness to returning to his former role.
b.title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ to return as Nvidia CEO
